data.name: Abdul
data.gender_notes: Abdul is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From ʿabd, 'servant, slave', used as the first element of theophoric names such as ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Abdul therefore means “Servant of (the)”. A prefix element in many Islamic theophoric names.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abdul expresses “Servant of (the)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From ʿabd, 'servant, slave', used as the first element of theophoric names such as ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdul total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

faq.q: What does the name Abdul mean?
Where does the name Abdul come from?
What is the linguistic root of Abdul?
faq.a: The root of Abdul is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d).

faq.q: How is Abdul written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Abdul is written عَبْد in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Abdul a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Abdul is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Abdul appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Abdul is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Abdul verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Servant of (the)” is established by A prefix element in many Islamic theophoric names..
